posts.author: frikineitor143
posts.body:
Hello! Sorry if this sound dumb, I guess is common knoledge in here.
How can I give "types" to the enemies and characters with weakness in battle? Like pokemon.
Yes, I know there are pluggins for that, but for me is already hard to move in the default version.
I can create states like "fire type" or skills like "water attack". I give the fire type state an extra weakness to water-type attacks but how can I make that state stay in the enemy or the character in every battle forever?
Also I would like to include GIF format pics in my game, again, I know there are pluggins for that and tried to used one, but no matter how much I tried i didn´t make it work...is there a way that intercalate each image for some frames and create a loop until you pass a dialogue or something?
Thank you very much

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
If you're using Yanfly/VisuStella, I think the Elements Core (or possible it was called Elements and States Core?) has a facility to do this.
With no plugins, normally what you'd do is put the weakness directly on the enemy (instead of on a state) and copy-paste it to all enemies that need it.
If you like the idea of doing it as a state, there should be at least one passive states plugin that'll allow you to permanently give the enemy that state.
GIF images are not supported. I do remember seeing a plugin that makes animated face images (without using GIF). Presumably there could exist plugins that use GIF; I don't know anything about such plugins though.
